subject: Welcome — choose an EMEA-friendly window for a quick Redwood walkthrough
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jan 2028 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Thanks for signing up — quick walkthrough options

Hi Alex —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood! I’m Irene from the Growth team — welcome. We automatically provision a short 15-minute walkthrough to help get you past the first steps and show how Redwood can plug into your infra. If you prefer to skip scheduling, you can also follow the quickstart guide in your account.

If you’d like a live walkthrough, pick a 15-minute slot that works for you: https://cal.redwood.ai/s/soojin-15min

A couple of quick notes we usually cover in the call:
- the right model/quantization tradeoffs for production cost
- demo of the console trace and per-route cost view
- how to pin a model version and rollback safely

If you already know the timezone and whether a backend engineer will join, include that in your reply and my colleague Soojin (cc’d) will match the time.

Best,
Irene Choi
Growth Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: acme-intake-form.pdf (stub)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Thanks for signing up — quick walkthrough options

Hi Alex — quick follow-up from Soojin on the SDR team. Happy to own scheduling and make sure someone from engineering is on the call if you want a technical deep-dive.

I saw you signed up via the self-serve flow — thanks. A couple of quick questions so I can send the right invite: 
1) Which timezone are you in? (UTC offset is fine)
2) Do you want a product overview only (15 min) or product + technical (30 min)?
3) Any specific integration (e.g., VPC, private deployment) you want us to cover?

Proposed quick EMEA windows I can offer this week (CET):
- Tue 17 Jan: 14:00–14:30 CET
- Wed 18 Jan: 09:30–10:00 CET
- Thu 19 Jan: 16:00–16:30 CET

If none of those work, reply with three preferred windows and I’ll match a seat. I’ve cc’d Karthik from infra in case you want the engineering perspective on the call.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
SDR, Redwood Inference

Hi Irene / Soojin —

Thanks — I’m Alex (Platform Lead at Acme Retail). I’m based in Berlin (CET / UTC+1). Weekdays after 15:30 CET are best for me. A 30-minute slot with a technical engineer would be ideal — we’re evaluating private deployment and want to ask about network patterns and KMS options.

Also: can the session be recorded? And could you send a short pre-call checklist so we can have the right people on?

I attached a short intake CSV from our side with account identifiers. Looking forward to the call.

Alex Johnson
Platform Lead, Acme Retail
alex@acme-retail.com

Thanks Alex — great, 30 minutes with an engineer makes sense given private deployment questions. I’ve proposed two EMEA-friendly times and added a recording option:

- Wed 18 Jan 15:30–16:00 CET (proposed)
- Fri 20 Jan 16:00–16:30 CET (alternate)

Please click the scheduling link to confirm the time that works for you: https://cal.redwood.ai/s/soojin-15min
I’ll include Karthik on the invite for the technical portion. We will record the session and share the recording after the meeting.

Pre-call checklist (attached) — quick items to have ready:
- list of workloads you plan to run (rough QPS / seq len)
- whether you prefer hosted/dedicated/private deployment
- any compliance or KMS requirements (SOC2 / HSM name)

Attachments included: precall-checklist.md, meeting-invite.ics

If you prefer, I can also send a calendar invite directly to your assistant (calendar+acme@example.com) — let me know.

See you soon,
Soojin Lee
SDR, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123
